environment: Windows 11 Pro x64, MSVC 19.51, GNS 1.6.1 and OpenSSL 3.6.5 via vcpkg 65a2c23, loopback; real time
game_exe_sha256: N/A (prototype does not touch the game)
objective: Implement ChatGPT reviews #13/#14 (FB-13-01..03, FB-14-01..03) on feature/review13-14-followup and validate the final head of the #12-#15 stack: harness hardening, KI-41 contract, secure E2E barrier, a predeclared UDP-only retry experiment, GNS phase distributions, full v6 battery with seeded repeats.
hypothesis: EXP-025's UDP gain from a 250 ms reconnect retry replicates on fresh seeds (UDP-only policy); the harness changes make suite transports and E2E start-up deterministic; the final head passes the v6 battery.
procedure: Measured KI-41 (30 runs with client logs). Implemented: ctest MORDOR_TRANSPORT pinning + tools/collab/check_test_transport.py in test.ps1; aborted runs counted apart in compare_arms.py; timeline.py --summary; scripts/hang-watch.ps1; explicit smoke-test contract; host --stop-file and the secure-e2e readiness barrier with gate participants_ready (checked positive on freshly relinked binaries and negative with -BarrierS 0). Predeclared EXP-026 in docs/soak-testing.md and committed it before its runs. Then, on 8d553a3, each step in its own process with hang-watch.ps1 running: suites x2 on both builds, E2E, asymmetric x4, secure E2E x4, EXP-026 (harsh-udp-secure A 500 / B 250 x 8 seeds 300..370), 8 default harsh-gns-secure runs (seeds 400..470), 12-scenario battery + 4 repeats per harsh secure profile (seeds 510..540).
expected_result: B adopted for UDP; all suites pass; the battery and repeats pass.
observed_result: KI-41: 30/30 extra runs passed (1 failure in 37 overall); contract made explicit. EXP-026 (rule as predeclared): A median 1632 max 2579 ms, B median 1918 max 2383 ms, 0 failures in each, no aborted run: B not adopted; EXP-025's UDP gain did not replicate. Suites: pass 1 all passed except contract_endpoint_reuse_gets_new_peer_generation on GNS (client saw no Disconnected within 5 s after the host closed the peer; KI-42); pass 2 all passed; the transport check passed both times (and was proven to fail on a wrong expectation). E2E, asymmetric 4/4, secure E2E 4/4 passed; the barrier recorded client logs appearing in 105-116 ms on freshly relinked binaries; a deliberate -BarrierS 0 run failed exactly participants_ready. GNS distribution runs: 6/8 passed (3334, 3525 ms failed). Battery: 12/12; repeats harsh-gns-secure 1/4 passed (4448, 3837, 3124 ms failed), harsh-udp-secure 3/4 passed (3158 ms failed). Pooled default policy at the head: harsh-gns-secure 5/13, harsh-udp-secure 1/13 over 3000 ms. GNS phase p50/p90: establishment 886/1580, DTLS 819/1529, session 690/1670, total 2588/3837 ms. Hang watcher: no stuck process.
errors: Hypothesis rejected (UDP gain did not replicate); KI-35 open with 5/13 GNS failures at the head; KI-42 new flake; KI-40/41 not reproduced in this run.
follow_up: KI-35 on GNS: all three phases contribute; candidates need a predeclared experiment each (e.g. skip the redundant DTLS cookie round trip on GNS per F-GNS-001, GNS connection-setup behaviour under loss); characterise KI-42; KI-28b; LAN test; external review.
